sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned Aga for the State and perused the record.

2. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the charge-sheet
no.15 of 2018 dated 24.04.2018 as well as entire proceedings of Case No. 224 of 2018 (State Vs. Vs.
Vishal Gupta and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 147 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 323, 504
and 506 Ipc and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Mahila Thana, District Varanasi, pending in the Court of
A.C.J.M.-Ist, Varanasi.

Vishal Gupta and others)

sentences.text: 3.  As per the allegations made in the first informant report, it is alleged that opposite party no. 2 was married to Vishal Gupta son of applicant no. 1 on 05.02.2017.
Applicant no.1 is the mother-in-law and applicant no. 2 is the married sister-in-law of opposite party no. 2

, however, after the said Meera Gupta And Anr vs State Of U.P. And Another on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168443112/
1 marriage, the applicants started demanding additional dowry and for non-fulfilment of demand of additional dowry, they started torturing and maltreating her and subjected her to cruelty and turned her out of her matrimonial home.
4.

entities.text: Meera Gupta And Anr vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that from the perusal of the allegations made in the FIR and the material collected during the course of investigation, no offence is disclosed against the applicants and the present prosecution has been instituted with a malafide intention for the purposes of harassment.
He has pointed out certain documents and statements in support of his contention.

5. Per contra, learned AGA has submitted that from the perusal of the allegations made in the FIR and the material collected during the course of investigation, prima facie, offence is clearly made out against applicant no. 1.
6.
Moreover, all the submissions made at the bar relates to the disputed question of fact, which cannot be adjudicated upon by this Court under Section 482 CrPC.

At this stage, only prima facie case is to be seen in the light of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the cases of R.P.
Kapur Vs. State of Punjab, AIR 1960 SC 866, State of Haryana Vs. Bhajan Lal, 1992 SCC (Cri.) 426,
State of Bihar Vs. P.P. Sharma, 1992 SCC (Cri.) 192 and lastly Zandu Pharmaceutical Works Ltd. Vs.
Mohd. Saraful Haq and another, (Para-10) 2005 SCC (Cri.) 283.
7.

sentences.text: The disputed defence of the accused cannot be considered at this stage.
8. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, so far as the applicant no. 1 is concerned, the prayer for quashing the entire proceedings is refused.

9. However, in case applicant no. 1 appears before the court below within three weeks from today and applies for bail, her bail application be considered and disposed of in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51 after hearing the parties.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 10. With the aforesaid observation, the instant application on behalf of applicant no. 1 stands disposed of.

11. So far as the applicant no.2 is concerned, learned counsel for the applicants has next submitted that there is no specific allegation of torturing and demanding dowry against her rather general and vague allegations, just to drag her in criminal court has been alleged and she has no concern whatsoever with her day to day affairs and has been falsely roped in only on account of being the sister of her husband.

12. In view of law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Taramani Parak Vs. State of M.P. and Others, (2015) 11 SCC 260 and Geeta Mehrotra and Another Vs. State of U.P. and Another,
(2012) 10 SCC 741, the aforesaid proceedings in respect of applicant no. 2 are quashed.
